name: code-quality
description: Runs a full-capability Codex review, freezes its raw output, then publishes a report-only classification; V1.2 remains offline-only.

interface.shortDescription: Run a full Codex review with frozen evidence
interface.longDescription: Review a trusted committed Git increment with one full Codex Agent call, immutable raw evidence, and deterministic post-classification.
defaultPrompt: Run the full Codex report-only review for this committed change and report the retained raw freeze and result paths.
